episode.title: Why Costco Checks Your Receipt — Quality Proof

scenes.title: You already paid. So why does Costco stop you again?
scenes.subtitle: The obvious answer is theft. Costco's own explanation is more interesting.

scenes.title: One purchase passes through four control points
A tiny checkout error creates two very different problems

left.title: MISSED ITEM
left.body: A case under the cart leaves without being scanned.
left.result: The member's bill is low — but the inventory system still thinks the item is inside.

right.title: DOUBLE SCAN
right.body: The same product is scanned twice.
right.result: Inventory may be fine — but the member paid too much.

scenes.detail: Costco says receipt verification checks cashier processing, maintains inventory-control accuracy, and helps ensure members were charged properly.
